source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The first prefill writes only truthy incoming and outgoing ports. Its alternative branches do not clear a previous value and contain automatic-port TODOs. captureState returns the stored config, while the new integration tests assert navigation to the form rather than its populated values. The accepted form later clears empty ports and delegates adjustment. Preserve these source phases separately; neither the tests nor a later fixed status proves all requested listeners or automatic behavior landed in the first patch.
title: The first manual-config prefill leaves automatic port updates as TODOs
